candidates.name: Zietlow Installers & Distributors
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists toilet partitions among products it supplies and installs; customer testimonial about church bathroom partitions delivered and installed.
red_flags: Describes itself as a distributor: supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: Commercial installer and distributor since 1970 that installs toilet partitions for schools, churches and offices; serves Cleveland, Medina and Cuyahoga County. It also distributes partitions, so buy-around risk.

license.name: Zietlow Installers & Distributors
license.registry: City of Akron contractor registration (Plans and Permits Center, Engineering Bureau), done through the Plan Review and Permits web portal
license.note: Base city North Ridgeville. Akron says it 'requires all contractors regardless of trade to register as a contractor if the work they are preforming requires a permit' (Akron tax registration number, $3 million liability insurance, workers' comp where the contractor has employees). The City publishes no registered-contractor list and no public lookup. Its Cityworks portal offers only sign-in or creating an application as a guest. Confirm registration by phone with the Plans and Permits Center (330-375-2010, the number on the City's renewal form, found via search; not opened).
